import itertools
TPOS=[(42,21),(42,26),(42,31),(42,36),(42,41)]
def tstate():
    c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [c[42][cc] for (r,cc) in TPOS]
def set_state(target):
    cur=tstate()
    for i,(want) in enumerate(target):
        if cur[i]!=want:
            r,cc=TPOS[i]
            action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':cc}])
            cur=tstate()
def gameplay_diff():
    b=previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    d=[(r,cc) for r in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[r][cc]!=c[r][cc] and r!=1 and not(42<=r<=46 and 19<=cc<=43)]
    return d
found=None
for bits in itertools.product('Bw',repeat=5):
    set_state(bits)
    # after setting, check if any non-toggle change happened on the last click
    d=gameplay_diff()
    if d:
        found=(bits,d[:8]); break
print('found',found)
print('final state',tstate())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

import itertools
TPOS=[(42,21),(42,26),(42,31),(42,36),(42,41)]
def tstate():
    c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [c[42][cc] for (r,cc) in TPOS]
def set_state(target):
    cur=tstate()
    for i,(want) in enumerate(target):
        if cur[i]!=want:
            r,cc=TPOS[i]
            action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':cc}])
            cur=tstate()
def gameplay_diff():
    b=previous_frame.ascii.split('\n'); c=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    d=[(r,cc) for r in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[r][cc]!=c[r][cc] and r!=1 and not(42<=r<=46 and 19<=cc<=43)]
    return d
found=None
for bits in itertools.product('Bw',repeat=5):
    set_state(bits)
    # after setting, check if any non-toggle change happened on the last click
    d=gameplay_diff()
    if d:
        found=(bits,d[:8]); break
print('found',found)
print('final state',tstate())
